description: Docking-noise floor versus microstate-induced validity flip on CASF-2016

columns.name: n_complexes
columns.description: affected complexes with a flip fraction and a noise estimate

columns.name: microstate_flip_rate
columns.description: mean over complexes of the single-vs-dominant flip fraction (over seeds)

columns.name: noise_flip_rate
columns.description: mean over complexes of the seed-pair disagreement of the SAME microstate (single and dominant averaged)

columns.name: p_wilcoxon_paired
columns.description: Wilcoxon signed-rank on the paired complex differences (two-sided)

columns.name: z_naive
columns.description: pooled two-proportion z (units treated as independent; descriptive only)

columns.name: p_holm
columns.description: Holm over the 5 criteria of p_wilcoxon_paired
